safe_cex_store::model_patch::PatchModel:.reason: Reviewed model_patch.rs: the crate-private PatchModel impl for Market decodes one patch field per call into a cloned candidate; model_patch::apply commits the candidate only after every field succeeds. Its only callers are the Store update entrypoints taking &dyn PatchSource, which the inventory treats as raw input, so field-decoding coverage belongs to those public owners' probes, not to this private receiver.
